correctness.rationale: The proof has two exhaustive affine-span cases. Character restriction gives exact multiplicity \(2^{d-r}\). For \(r=2\), invertibility and finite-hyperplane avoidance realize every nonempty local Fourier support. For \(r=3\), the cube-affine formula excludes Hamming-distance-one and antipodal zero pairs because all four time coefficients are nonzero; four remaining candidate zeros would form a parity tetrahedron and force the constant coefficient to vanish. Explicit nonzero coefficient quadruples attain exactly \(0,1,2,3\) zeros. The exact rational verifier independently classifies all \(256\) local zero subsets. No assertion outside exact four-point support on elementary abelian two-groups is used.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the exact four-sparse stratum on the infinite family \((\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^d\). The affine support dimension is a mathematically intrinsic invariant, the affine-independent obstruction gives a sharp new local boundary, and the exact zero-pattern theorem explains rather than merely enumerates the attainable cells. The result is more informative than a minimum bound and directly converts prior small-order numerical evidence into a reusable structural statement.
